panels.description: Alex pulls the old book; it stops like a lever and dust puffs from the shelf. Keep the mechanism clear.
The bookshelf shifts by a fraction and dust sifts down. Keep the moving edge clear.

The bookshelf swings outward on a visible concealed vertical pivot with floor clearance, revealing a black passage. Golden room light spills across the floor. Alex steps back; Grandmother remains seated. Preserve the passage as the dominant shape and leave upper-left clear.
Grandmother smiles calmly as Alex turns from the passage toward her. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear.
Alex’s boot crosses from warm light into darkness. No lettering.

items.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
items.text: He said you'd know when you were ready.
